profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | React • TypeScript • Node.js | Fintech & Startup Experience
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with 6+ years in fintech startups and founder experience. I'm the guy from engineering that can build something on my own and work with teams across the organization to guide a feature or product from concept to deployed.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led development of the consumer mobile banking experience (React Native,
TypeScript), owning core app functionality across accounts, transactions, and shared
financial workflows.

Drove end-to-end delivery of mobile features across iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin/
Java), ensuring consistent cross-platform behavior and production stability.

Maintained and improved a high-availability financial system (99%+ uptime) in a
regulated fintech environment with strict reliability expectations.

Built and scaled backend services and APIs (Ruby on Rails, Apollo GraphQL)
supporting core banking workflows and mobile application data needs.

Designed and shipped internal tooling for people ops and support teams, reducing
operational friction and improving visibility into customer issues.

Introduced TypeScript adoption into an existing production codebase, improving type
safety, developer velocity, and long-term maintainability.

Partnered closely with product, design, and operations teams to take features from
early concepts through implementation, review, and production release.

Acted as a technical lead on cross-functional initiatives, driving architecture decisions
and coordinating delivery across multiple stakeholders.
positions.insights: Skills: Engineering · Mobile Application Development · Software Development · TypeScript · React Native

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Supported internal tools for Nearside agents. Designed and developed features for BBA customers. Promoted from L1 to Software Engineer L2. Utilized my Kotlin experience to support legacy tools. Heavily used React and Typescript while migrating, building, and supporting features.

Worked on migration to Node.js & PostgreSQL from Kotlin & PostgreSQL due to changes in our business banking partner. Designed and developed a critical internal dashboard tool to assist the auditing process. Our audit exceeded expectations which was essential to provide the time needed for our team to meet our goals.

Successfully helped migrate our entire customer base, with a new backend architecture, new endpoints and design patterns. Worked on frontend integration with a refreshed frontend design and brand new API shape responses. During and post migrations, our customers experienced no unexpected service interruption and very little planned and communicated service interruption.  

After the migration, worked on re-enabling all the features we had before migration. Also worked on edge case issues that came up with, essentially, a single authentication system with two applications that needed to seamlessly work together; one for our legacy products and one for our primary banking product.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Promoted from 3 month contract to hire in 1 month. Received another promotion prior to our ladders and levels program. Then, promoted from L0 to L1. Designed and developed several greenfield projects and customer facing production features and tools. Built several critical user-facing features that served 10,000+ customers. 

Examples of projects I worked on:
- Built the v0 self-serve customer profile and business profile pages, which is still in production today.
- Built the perks portal v0, where customers could benefit from strategic partnerships marketing had curated for them.
- Refactored the payments portals clearing up confusion between when a transaction was initiated and when it would clear.
- In an effort to make it easier for future developers to onboard, I documented frontend systems, design patterns, and desired improvements. Also updated documentation when things changed as much as possible. 
- Redesigned, built, and owned our internal tools v1 that agents used daily to interact with our customers asynchronously, when applications required manual review. Internal tools featured full CRUD capability including document upload and secure communication channels. 
- Co-developed v0 of our incident response system. The incident response system evolved, with little change, into v1 which every existing and new employee was trained with.

Due to a business need to migrate to Node.js, I learned Kotlin, Spring, some Java patterns, OOP principles and provided support for our legacy backend so we could continue development of our internal agent tools.

positions.title: Section Lead
positions.description:
Managed PM/TLs across 2 cohorts with 3 different curriculum tracks who, in turn, managed more than 100 students. Worked closely with Lambda team and instructors to coordinate the efforts of PM/TLs in a rapidly changing environment.

Hosted support for Team Leads and students for curriculum materials such as JS fundamentals, React, React Redux, axios, Node.js, Express, passport.js, mapbox, graphql/prisma/apollo, and REST apis. 

Used version control software (git, github), Figma, MacOS, and Illustrator.

positions.title: Teacher Assistant
positions.description: Worked directly with at risk students to teach and reinforce CSS/LESS/Sass styling and preprocessors, JS fundamentals, React SPA architecture patterns, React Redux, Express/Node.js.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description: Managed up to 25 students at a time. Tracked student progress, graded projects, hosted agile-style standup meetings, code reviews, identified and provided focused help for students in need, supported students in JS Fundamentals and React State/Props.

positions.title: Web Developer / Designer
positions.description:
Worked directly with business owners to update and craft brand presence both online and offline. Designed billboards, signage, paper assets, logos, style guides.

Built full stack web applications from draft to deployment mostly using the LAMP stack (HTML, CSS, JS, PHP, MySQL) which I subsequently maintained, but also some smaller CMS projects. Designed with Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, and Figma. Used git, dropbox, docker, Debian Linux, and windows.
positions.insights: Skills: Adobe Creative Suite · Node.js · React.js · Python (Programming Language) · Graphic Design · JavaScript · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Strategy · React · Bitcoin · SASS · Entrepreneurship · Business Strategy

positions.title: Founder, CEO
positions.description:
Dollero facilitated transfers of money through the Ripple protocol by providing simple and easy-to-use solutions for the user to interact with. We did user-research to understand what they need, how, why, when, and where they need it. Features we developed were enhanced through careful analysis of real-life usage while remaining familiar to the people who use it. Provided open and fair access to move money throughout the world with the ease of information. 

Crypto based remittance solution to meet the needs of the PI to US corridor.

Started from an idea which blossomed into a team of 8. Personally managed hiring, fundraising, and marketing. Personally built marketing collateral, marketing sites, and pitch decks. Successfully raised money, and the development team built prototypes of payment terminal software.

Worked with remote teams, websockets, React, swift, prototype physical terminals, and the Ripple network.
positions.insights: Skills: Math-based Currencies · Start-ups · Graphic Design · Management · JavaScript · Strategy · Bitcoin · Strategic Planning · Entrepreneurship · Business Strategy · Leadership

positions.title: Event Organizer
positions.description:
Co-chaired the Virtual Currency event held on June 18th.  Originally, I was brought on as a bitcoin/crypto-currency consultant because of my domain expertise but quickly transitioned into a leadership role.  Not to say that this was not a group effort; the team that I worked with on this event was probably one of the most efficient teams I've worked with.  Everyone of these people I would happily work with again in both a npo and business capacity.  

While working with VLAB, I successfully helped craft the panels of and organize two events: Virtual Currencies and Privacy Startups. Links below to the videos.
positions.insights: Skills: Math-based Currencies · Strategy · Event Planning · Bitcoin · Strategic Planning · Business Strategy · Leadership

company.name: VLAB - MIT Enterprise Forum, Bay Area

positions.title: Business Development
positions.description:
Goodjoe was a clothing and accessories platform that provided freelance designers with an opportunity to reach new customers while providing donations for their preferred Non-Profit Organization (NPO).

Managed customer acquisition, targeted NPOs using my network, social networks, email, and phone calls. Closely managed production flow and growth with screen printers.

Executed strategic development of marketing and brand. 

Developed and implemented strategies to raise capital to grow the company.
positions.insights: Skills: Marketing · New Business Development · Event Planning · Business Development · Business Strategy

positions.title: Finance Manager
positions.description: Generate and maintain relationships with clients and with lenders. Managed a team of loan officers helping them meet deadlines and requirements for funding. Developed strategies with my team and other managers to grow and maintain our network of clients.
positions.insights: Skills: Marketing · Account Management · New Business Development · Sales · Closings · Finance · Management · Strategy · Business Development · Strategic Planning · Business Strategy · Leadership
